name: handoff-workflow
description: The journey → handoff → implement → verify pipeline for shipping substantial work on lanius, with deliberate model-tiering across the phases. Use when Tim asks to plan a feature, write or "knock out" handoff docs, implement a spec, or orchestrate implementation + verification — anything bigger than a quick edit. Encodes who plans vs implements vs verifies, which model/effort fits each phase, how to dispatch clean-context worker agents, and the containment + commit discipline that keeps the repo clean. Fable should *ALWAYS* follow the second-level workflow specified below.
